heading: Choose what works for you
intro: A little ongoing support helps me make time for development, maintenance and the next useful idea.
frequency: How would you like to contribute?
minimum: Minimum A$5. You can review everything before paying.
checkoutNote: Add an optional name and message at checkout. Sharing is always your choice.
noScript: Please enable JavaScript to choose a contribution or manage your public details. You can also contact support@villow.app for help.
recentHeading: A little encouragement goes a long way
recentIntro: The 10 most recent shared supporter entries, shared with permission. Thank you to everyone who supports the work, publicly or privately.
portalBody: Update your payment details or cancel through Stripe, using your checkout email.
portalUnavailable: Payment management will be available here when support launches.
removalBody: Enter your checkout email. We'll send a secure link to remove your public name and message from Villow's shared supporter feed. Your subscription stays as it is.
confirmBody: This removes all your public supporter details for Villow. It doesn't cancel monthly support. Your name and message will also stay private on future contributions using this email.

client.unavailable: Support payments aren't open yet. Please check back soon.
client.test: Test checkout — no real money will be taken.
client.ready: Secure checkout with Stripe. All amounts are in AUD.
client.error: We couldn't connect just now. Please try again shortly.
client.empty: Messages shared with permission will appear here after payment. Some may wait for review.
client.invalidAmount: Enter a one-time amount between A$5 and A$10,000, with at most two decimal places.
client.returned: Thank you for supporting Villow. Shared messages usually appear after payment is confirmed. Some wait for a quick review.
client.cancelled: Checkout was closed. You can choose another amount whenever you're ready.
